Inventory Items — Average cost — Recalculate

The Recalculate Average Cost feature allows you to update the average cost of your inventory items in Manager. This ensures that your inventory valuations are accurate, especially after transactions that affect item costs.

Accessing the Recalculate Feature

To recalculate the average cost of your inventory items:

  1. Navigate to the Inventory Items tab.

  2. Locate the Average Cost column.

  3. Click the Recalculate button above the Average Cost column.

If the Recalculate Button Is Not Visible

If you do not see the Recalculate button:

  • It means the Average Cost column is not currently visible.

  • To display the Average Cost column:

    1. Use the Edit Columns feature.
    2. Select the Average Cost column to make it visible.

For more details on customizing columns, refer to the Edit Columns Guide.

Alternative Access Points

The Recalculate button is also accessible when drilling down into the Inventory on hand account from:

  • The Summary tab.
  • Financial statements such as the Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, or General Ledger Summary.

Performing the Recalculation

When you click the Recalculate button:

  1. Manager recalculates the average cost for each inventory item.
  2. If there are changes since the last recalculation, the new Average Cost values are displayed.

Applying the Updated Costs

To accept and apply the recalculated average costs:

  1. Review the updated Average Cost values.

  2. Click the Batch Update button at the bottom of the screen.

If No Updates Are Needed

If the recalculated average costs match the existing values:

  • A message stating All values are up to date will appear.

  • Click the Go back button to return to the previous screen.

By regularly recalculating average costs, you ensure that your inventory valuations remain accurate and reflect the most recent transaction data.
